Admission auctions defeat bulk forgery: 100 slots/epoch, sealed-bid, so a farmer chasing 1,000 slots bids against itself, raising prices.

One thread links bid to activation: bids escrow 3 epochs, winners face 2-epoch probation, peers challenge forgeries; proven fraud burns the bid.

Cost closes the horizon: at 50 units, 1,000 identities cost 51,000, and doubling demand doubles price, so 10,000 cost 1,000,000+ — a dune steepening as it grows.
